description.value: Ibex Café + Kitchen is a café and full kitchen situated in the Burke Mountain neighbourhood of Coquitlam, serving brunch and coffee as well as wine and dinner options. It is positioned at the base of Burke Mountain, a popular destination for hikers and mountain bikers, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists coming off the trails or passing through the area. Outdoor seating is available according to OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content retrieved is almost entirely cookie consent/GDPR banner text, with no substantive business content visible; only the page titles yield useful information (front page: 'Wine and Dine at Burke Mountain, Coquitlam'; contact page: 'Brunch & Coffee in Burke Mountain, Coquitlam'). OSM tags confirm it is a café with outdoor seating at 3537 Princeton Avenue, Coquitlam. Because the website body content is inaccessible, amenity fields default to null and contact confirmation relies only on the URL match.
